label: hypothetical_light_ev_van
consumption_note: Assumed constant Wh/km for a small electric van under urban conditions. Not calibrated to HELECAR-D passenger cars without qualification. Usable range before reserve under this model is about 170 km per vehicle; whether energy binds depends on realized route distances, not this sheet alone.
problem_class_note: Depot-only charging makes this closer to a dynamic energy-constrained pickup VRP than classical EVRP with en-route charging-station routing.
